{{Version|2.2.23}}
[[File:Skill-Tree Button.png|frameless|left]]
The Skill Tree is unlocked at Obelisk Level 4. The Skill Tree contains several permanent upgrades that carry over after you [[Prestige]]. A Skill can be acquired with skill points. Skill points can be obtained by combining 10 skill bits (which can be obtained from [[Store#Freebie Pack|Freebies]], in [[Store#Gifts|Gifts]], or from [[Events]]) in the item bag, from the [[Store]] for 125 gems, and from some [[Codes]].

{{Clear|left}}
==Strategy==
Below is a recommended Skill order mentioning the S-Tier skills for the early game.

* [[#GemsAndChests|Gems & Chests]] (Right Side)
* [[#EasyProgressor|Easy Progressor]] (Right Side)
* [[#JustWaitFaster|Just wait faster]] (Right Side)
* [[#Chronokeeper|Chronokeeper]] (Left Side)
* [[#AutoBomb|Auto-Bomber]] (Left Side)
* [[#FreeThatsAGreatPrice|Free? That's a great price]] (Left Side)
* [[#GemBomb|Gem Bomb]] (Right Side)
* [[#Stonks|Stonks]] (Right Side)

==Trivia==
* Before the '''Arsenal Advancement''' got upgraded to have more upgrades, there was the '''Bomb Bag+''' which '''Increase Bomb Capacity +1'''.
* Currently, a grand total of '''189081 skill points''' is required to unlock all skills. However, if ''Portal Schmortal'', ''Straight Outta Yanille'', ''Mess With The Bull'' and ''Fronks'' were excluded, a total would be only 18714 skill points.
* Until [[Update:1.8.90]], [[#EasyProgressor|Easy Progressor]] was a Must-Have "S-Tier" skill, because it used to unlock the "Auto-Floor" button. As most beginners weren't looking for skills, it was removed to be more accessible. In more recent version, the Auto-Floor is automatically unlocked at the start of the game.
